description: Floor positions of the two speakers from the fixed camera, one row per processed video frame.
time_base: t_wav_s = seconds in data/audio_4ch.wav (zero = start of the iPhone Air file) = video time - video_sync offset_s
frame: floor frame of devices.json: x across the hall from the left wall, y along the hall away from the camera, metres (x range 0 to 3.04)

columns.x_m_y_m: raw position, blank if not detected

speakers.A: the person with the darker trousers
speakers.B: the person with the lighter trousers

method: YOLO11m-pose ankles -> floor homography; speakers separated by thigh colour
caveats: Ankle-based. Floor resolution is about 3 cm/px at 5 m and 6 cm/px at 9 m in 1080p (twice that in this 720p video), so expect errors of 0.1 m near the camera and more at the far end, plus the grid's own 0.9 in. A person whose feet are cut off by the bottom of the frame (very close to the camera) is 'lost'. Speakers are told apart by trouser colour, so a wrong swap is possible when the two stand close together.
